cli.title: Command-line access
cli.description: Install the cockpit-chess command-line tool and manage the keys it can use.

install.title: Install or update
install.description: Paste one of these commands into a terminal. Running it again updates cockpit-chess to the latest version; <0>cockpit-chess update</0> does the same from inside the tool.
install.expiresAt: This command contains a one-time sign-in token and stops working at {{time}} (15 minutes). Don't share it.
install.nextStep: After installing, run <0>cockpit-chess login</0> and approve the request in your browser.
install.unavailableDescription: This server isn't configured to serve the command-line tool yet. Ask an administrator to set CLI_RELEASE_REPO.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For CI jobs and scripts that can't open a browser. For your own terminal, use <0>cockpit-chess login</0> instead. API keys can't be used for admin actions.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key to use cockpit-chess from CI or a script.

create.title: Create API key
create.description: Name the key after where it will be used, so you know which one to revoke later.
create.createdWarning: This is the only time the key is shown. Store it in your CI secrets or a password manager now.
create.usage: Pipe it to <0>cockpit-chess login --with-api-key</0> or set the <1>COCKPIT_CHESS_API_KEY</1> environment variable.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke API key
revokeDialog.description: Anything using this key will stop working immediately. This can't be undone.
revokeDialog.typeNameToConfirm: Type the key's name to confirm:
